policy_source_evidence.independent_testability_review: Assigned Astra test author read-only response, no edits/execution: eight risk groups real execution/coverage, calibration, mod/dependency, combination, issuer/cache, actual host Apply, missing-mod save restore, U03 gate. Incorporated changed-definition coverage, instrumentation/seed identity, real runtime-combination positive control, approved immutable bytes, restored-mod positive save control and faulted-generation refusal.

performance_criterion_boundary.policy_decided: Only measured/calibrated versioned finite criteria can approve. Methods, exact field semantics, complete samples, threshold boundary tests and actual normal Apply are mandatory GEX deliverables.
performance_criterion_boundary.why_not_unresolved_user_policy: Existing LAB requires evidence before numeric selection; explicit current user instruction delegates measured engineering limits. This policy neither invents numbers nor claims present calibration. P2G20 must identify actual implementation/measurement ports and return if a material premise cannot be satisfied.
performance_criterion_boundary.completion_gate: Do not declare U11/Apply complete with an uncalibrated or diagnostic-only profile. Do not move required calibration into U30 or rely only on synthetic threshold inputs.

limitations: Policy meaning and selection process decided; numeric calibration/product/source review/test execution not completed.
Current user delegation owns measured criteria; unsupported numbers or altered gameplay/data semantics require owner review.
